title: ocr-pages page record
description: One JSON file per physical page, named page-<folio>.json.

source.description: Filename of the photograph this page came from.

side.description: Which half of a spread. null for single-page photos.

folio.description: The page number printed on the page, which is the page's real identity. null when the page carries none (chapter openers usually don't). Roman numerals stay strings.

order.description: Position in the capture sequence. Used to sort when folio is missing or unreliable.

text.description:
Verbatim text. May contain only: , ,
, , , , and N. Escape literal & < > characters.

n.description: For type 'note' only: the note's number, so references can link to it.

continued.description: This block finishes a paragraph begun on the previous page.

continues.description: This block is interrupted by the page break and resumes on the next page.

uncertain.description: Exact substrings of `text` that were hard to read. Each is underlined in the rendered HTML so a reviewer knows where to check the photograph. Prefer listing a doubtful reading over silently committing to it.
